method.ratio_all: Who wants to be hired? top-level comments / Who is hiring? top-level comments, counting every top-level comment id in the Firebase item's `kids` (includes deleted and dead).
method.ratio_visible: Same, counting only top-level comments still visible today (Algolia items API `children` with text and author; equals kids minus deleted minus dead).
method.skills: One regex per skill over visible comment text; a comment counts once per skill. seekers_per_job_3m = seeking hits / hiring hits summed over the month and the two before it. Seeker posts list long 'Technologies:' stacks, so compare skills with each other, not with the overall ratio.
method.jolts: FRED JTSJOL (JOLTS job openings, SA, thousands) / FRED UNEMPLOY (CPS unemployed, SA, thousands).
method.complete: False while either thread is younger than 14 days.
